cards.title: Documentation of Modeling Parameters and Assumptions
cards.claim: All system-specific and drug-specific parameters must be clearly specified with their sources and justifications. Key model assumptions impacting application, including biological rationales and mathematical representations, must be explicitly stated.
conditions: Parameter values must be justified with appropriate references.
If multiple sources exist for a parameter, the selection process must be described.
Use of clinical PK data to optimize parameters must be described and justified.
Library models (e.g., virtual populations) must be justified, and modifications must be identified.
required_inputs: Table of drug-dependent parameters (names, values, units, sources).
Procedures for assessing parameter uncertainty (e.g., sensitivity analysis).
Justification for any modifications to library models.
limitations: Does not prescribe specific parameter estimation methods.
Does not define acceptable ranges for parameter uncertainty.
cards.downstream_use: Ensuring transparency in human simulation inputs and enabling reproducibility of the model structure.

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
